working_definition: Author cell type 'spermatid' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult flies), annotated by the authors with FBbt:00004942 'spermatid'. Found in: 10x:male_reproductive_glands (434 cells), 10x:testis (643 cells), ss2:male_reproductive_glands (3 cells), ss2:testis (3 cells).
searches_performed: 'adult spermatid' (exact label / exact synonym, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: One of 64, post meiotic, haploid male germ cells in a spermatid cyst, connected to other spermatids by cytoplasmic bridges. The loss of these cytoplasmic bridge (individualisation) marks the end of the spermatid stage.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00004942 'spermatid', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
recommendation: Map to the authors' term FBbt:00004942 'spermatid', exact match.
